rule: ruling:sam-2026-10-07 claim ruling-sam-2026-10-07-p1-010: a real constraint the prototype cannot express overrides the prototype default; conflict c-006 already settled by precedence that this override covers accessibility, and named the deletion message's success banner as keeping no auto-dismiss, so the same rule settles this same difference.
outcome: The deletion success banner does not dismiss itself: it stays until the trader leaves or reloads the page, as today's GOV.UK success notification banner with role alert does. A message that disappears on a timer can vanish before a screen-reader or slow reader has it (WCAG 2.2.1), an accessibility duty the prototype cannot express, which ruling:sam-2026-10-07's real-constraint override covers as applied in c-006. Everything else about the banner follows Design Release 2.1.
